subject: Renewal: Private footprint expansion & isolation plan
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@clearpointhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.example, lauren_bishop@redwood.example
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 15:04:00 -0400
Subject: Renewal: Private footprint expansion & isolation plan

Hi Karthik / Lauren,

Our renewal for the private deployment is coming up on 2026-09-15. We need to expand the environment to add two new tenant zones (East-Coast Analytics, and West-Coast Archive) and ensure strict isolation between them for compliance with a new state regulation. High-level asks from our side: 

- Separate VPCs with dedicated cluster pools (no shared nodes)
- HSM-backed key management for the analytics cluster
- 24-month term with fixed pricing for capacity growth
- SOC 2 evidence and an updated data retention policy in the agreement

I've attached our current compliance checklist and the provisional PO the procurement team can sign once we align on price and SOW. Can we get a capacity + cost delta and a draft amendment that covers tenancy isolation?

Also: legal is asking for a clear rollout plan that shows when each cluster will be provisioned and when we can cutover. We have a 60-day procurement window if pricing is approved.

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Head of Platform Operations
ClearPoint Health
maria.lopez@clearpointhealth.com
(415) 555-0189

Attachment: compliance_checklist.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.example <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>

Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.example, marcus_lin@redwood.example
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: Private footprint expansion & isolation plan

Hi Maria — thanks for the clear summary. 

We can absolutely support two distinct tenant VPCs with dedicated cluster pools and HSM integration. Initial read: add four additional GPU nodes (2 per tenant) sized for your analytics workload plus an archival set with CPU/GPU mix for batch jobs. I'll put together a mutual action plan (MAP) and a draft SOW that captures the term amendment and the timeline.

Proposed immediate next steps: 
- Internal sizing and cost delta (we'll have a preliminary number by EOD Friday)
- Security runbook draft from our side for isolation controls (Marcus to lead)
- Legal/Contract redline checklist (we can publish a tracked amendment for your team)
- Schedule a 30-min alignment call early next week to confirm procurement milestones

Can you confirm the desired SLA for the analytics tenant (99.9% vs 99.95%) and whether the HSM must be customer-managed (KMS/HSM)? That will change pricing.

Thanks — speak soon.

— Karthik Iyer

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.example <lauren_bishop@redwood.example>

Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.example, marcus_lin@redwood.example
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: Private footprint expansion & isolation plan

Maria — quick technical note from infra: 

- Recommended cluster topology: 2x A100 80GB nodes for each analytics tenant (steady-state), plus 2x T4-style nodes for archive workers. We will provision separate autoscaling groups per tenant to enforce node separation.
- Network: Strict VPC peering disabled; all cross-tenant comms through a controlled proxy we can webhook-audit.
- KV cache: no shared cache across tenants — we'll allocate per-tenant cache buckets.
- HSM: Redwood can integrate customer-managed HSM (we support AWS KMS + external HSM via PKCS#11). If ClearPoint requires dedicated HSM hardware, we need the procurement timeline to match lead time (~6 weeks).

I'll coordinate with Marcus on the security runbook and provide a topology diagram. If you can confirm the SLA target, we'll bake in appropriate reserve capacity.

- Lauren Bishop
Director, Solutions Architecture
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.example

Attachment: topology_edge_clusters.png (png, 240KB)

From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@clearpointhealth.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.example, karthik_iyer@redwood.example
Cc: procurement@clearpointhealth.com
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 11:34:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Renewal: Private footprint expansion & isolation plan

Thanks Lauren — 99.95% SLA for the analytics tenant please. HSM should be customer-managed (we run keys in our HSM). Procurement confirms PO_4512 attached; we need the commercial delta and a 24-month amendment that locks price for capacity growth. Legal also asked that the amendment include a rollback/fallback plan in case an isolation failure is observed during cutover.

Procurement timeline: approve in 6 weeks if we have the SOW and amendment by next Friday (2026-08-06). If that's not feasible we'll need to request a 2-week extension on the procurement window.

Maria
